title: Off Broadway Lounge – Club Night – June 29th 2013
author: madwire
excerpt: Absolutely incredible first night at the Off Broadway Lounge! The wait staff is exemplary and the atmosphere is fantastic. We rocked old school Hip Hop and Top 40 all night. By the end of the night everyone was dancing! Looking forward to another great night next week. DJ Dillon
